purpose: Traceable source catalog for the initial operational HoReCa knowledge graph. Source records describe provenance, not universal validity.

sources.title: Стандарты внешнего вида — план тренинга
sources.locator: DOCX; sections: clothing/uniform, personal hygiene, watches/jewelry, training plan and discussion questions
limitations: Corporate resort standard; not a universal dress code.
Restrictions on appearance and religious symbols require jurisdiction-specific legal and policy review before reuse.
Footwear is asked as a discussion question but the supplied text does not provide its answer.
sources.sensitive_content: Generalized; organization and personal identifiers excluded.

sources.title: Система операционного управления — управленческая эффективность
sources.locator: PPTX; 20 slides; management functions, situational leadership, work maturity levels, GROW
limitations: Training framework, not validated universal psychometric assessment.
Work maturity is evaluated relative to a task, not as a permanent label for a person.
Slide 11 contains a visual matrix and must be interpreted with its image, not text extraction alone.

sources.title: Календарный план директора
sources.date_status: historical October dates; year not stated in workbook; current applicability not verified
sources.locator: XLSX; sheets: «календарный план», «11-15.10», «18-19.10»; main sheet rows 2–42; weekly plan/fact sheets rows 3–43; workbook inspected directly
limitations: Time budgets, frequency labels and the 21-workday calculation base are examples from one organization-specific operating model, not universal standards.
Blank planned occurrence counts and blank plan/fact cells remain unknown/not entered; they must not be converted to zero.

Weekly sheets contain historical plan/fact observations; sheet «18-19.10» repeats weekday headings for 11–15.10 and has predominantly blank fact cells, so its date range and actual execution cannot be reliably inferred.

The workbook does not consistently specify accountable owners, evidence records, acceptance criteria or escalation routes for each activity; these must remain unknown unless another source supports them.
Some abbreviations (РУ, ШП, FBC, МС, СШ, СЗ, ТМЦ) are not expanded in the workbook and are retained without speculative interpretation.
Historical plan/fact values are not benchmarks and must not be generalized to other restaurant formats or current organizations.

sources.title: Модель бизнес-процессов ресторана
sources.locator: XLSX; sheet БМ; 336 rows; process hierarchy and functional actions
limitations: Contains owner names and corporate references; these are excluded from generalized graph.
Some legacy terms, software references and legal/tax workflows may be obsolete or jurisdiction-specific.
A listed process is not proof that it is implemented or legally required.

sources.title: Стандарт качества обслуживания гостей (2025)
sources.locator: PDF; 43 pages; guest journey, service stages, sales, atypical situations and complaints
limitations: The document states it contains confidential information for named concepts; graph stores generalized concepts only.
Brand-specific scripts and operational details are not universal.
Current legal, accessibility, labor and food-safety applicability requires separate verification.

sources.title: Регламент ресторана
sources.date_status: not_verified; examples within the document include 2012 dates
sources.locator: DOC; contents cover concepts, operations, production and sales, safety, records, cash, payroll, procurement, POS, audits, marketing, delivery, HR, facilities and appendices
limitations: Historical and chain-specific; contains personal names, addresses, suppliers, internal contacts and software procedures excluded from graph.
All legal/tax/payroll statements require current official-source review for the relevant jurisdiction.
Legacy system instructions are not portable implementation guidance.
